node.statement: Invoke lem-maincb-structural-assembly and fix its universal MAIN-CB witness-ledger datum W. Define C_E := W.c0_cb*W.K_call and epsilon_E := W.epsilon_MAIN. The final clause of lem-maincb-structural-assembly states that these two quantities are finite positive universal witnesses; therefore C_E < infinity and epsilon_E > 0, with neither depending on dimension, amplification level, block count, or block dimensions.
